cpp.name: 1v1 Arena
cpp.desc: Adds a 1v1 arena bracket to the arena system -- queue solo duels through the arena NPC.

cpp.name: AoE Loot
cpp.desc: Loot every nearby corpse with one click, retail-style.

cpp.name: Auction House Bot
cpp.desc: Keeps the Auction House stocked and buying: a bot lists and purchases items so the economy works on a solo server.

cpp.name: Auction House Bot Plus (blizzlike pricing)
cpp.desc: Enhanced Auction House Bot fork: fully customizable, blizzlike pricing by category/quality/item level, conf-only (no SQL). Replaces mod-ah-bot -- install one or the other, not both.

cpp.name: Auto Balance (dynamic difficulty)
cpp.desc: Scales dungeon/raid mob health and damage to your party size, so any group size can run any instance.

cpp.name: AzerothCore Lua Engine (ALE)
cpp.desc: The Lua scripting engine (Eluna fork) that powers every script in the Lua/ALE family below -- install this first.

cpp.name: Bot Level Brackets (Playerbot distribution)
cpp.desc: Spreads the random playerbot population across level ranges you configure, instead of everyone clustering at cap.

cpp.name: Challenge Modes (Hardcore, Iron Man, etc.)
cpp.desc: Opt-in challenge rulesets per character: Hardcore (death is final), Iron Man, slow-XP and friends, with rewards.

cpp.name: Custom Login (starter gear + rep on first login)
cpp.desc: Gives freshly created characters configurable starter gear, items, and reputation on first login.

cpp.name: Individual Progression (Vanilla -> TBC -> WotLK)
cpp.desc: Each character progresses through Vanilla -> TBC -> WotLK content gates individually, like a personal timeline.

cpp.name: Junk to Gold (auto-sell gray items)
cpp.desc: Automatically sells gray junk for gold the moment you loot it.

cpp.name: Learn Spells on Levelup
cpp.desc: Class spells are learned automatically on level-up -- no class-trainer visits.

cpp.name: NPC Beastmaster (pets for all classes)
cpp.desc: A Beastmaster NPC that lets ANY class tame, stable and use hunter pets.

cpp.name: Quest Loot Party (quest items drop for all eligible party members)
cpp.desc: Quest items drop for every eligible party member at once instead of one at a time.

cpp.name: All Races All Classes (ARAC - data mod: SQL + DBC + MPQ)
cpp.desc: All Races, All Classes: unlocks every race/class combo. After install, click 'Apply client patch' on this row (server DBCs + client Patch-A.MPQ), then restart -- the server part alone is not enough.

cpp.name: Dungeon Master (roguelike dungeon challenge system)
cpp.desc: Roguelike dungeon challenge system: scaling runs with modifiers and escalating rewards.

cpp.name: Solocraft (solo dungeon/raid scaling)
cpp.desc: Scales YOU up when entering dungeons/raids under-manned, so soloing instances is viable.

cpp.name: Talent Button (dual-spec at 10 + anywhere talent reset)
cpp.desc: Dual spec from level 10 and a talent-reset button usable anywhere.

cpp.name: Transmogrification
cpp.desc: Transmogrification NPC: reskin your gear's appearance while keeping its stats.

lua.name: Accountwide Systems (achievements, currency, mounts, pets)
lua.desc: Shares achievements, currency, mounts and pets across every character on the same account.

lua.name: Azeroth Chatter (lore-grounded ambient world RP chat)
lua.desc: Ambient lore-flavored NPC chatter around the world, so cities feel alive.

lua.name: Battle Pass System (XP progression + rewards)
lua.desc: A battle-pass style XP track with tiered rewards for playing.

lua.name: Black Market Auction House (MoP-style BMAH + client addon)
lua.desc: MoP-style Black Market Auction House with rare/unobtainable items (server script + client addon).

lua.name: Loot Pet (vanity pet auto-loots nearby corpses)
lua.desc: Your vanity pet trots around auto-looting nearby corpses for you.

lua.name: Paragon Anniversary (endless post-80 stat progression + client files)
lua.desc: Endless post-80 'paragon' stat progression with client-side UI files.

lua.name: Sit Means Rest (regen buff on /sit; strips on movement)
lua.desc: Sitting down grants a rest/regen buff; standing or moving strips it.

lua.name: Season of Discovery Buffs (phased leveling XP rate bonus)
lua.desc: Season-of-Discovery-style phased XP rate bonuses while leveling.

lua.name: Unlimited Ammo (auto-refills Hunter arrows/bullets)
lua.desc: Hunters never run out: arrows and bullets auto-refill.

sql.name: All Stackables to 200
sql.desc: Raises stack sizes to 200 for everything stackable.

sql.name: Baby Mobs (HPx0.25 / DMGx0.25 / ARMx0.25)
sql.desc: World tweak: all mobs at quarter health/damage/armor -- easy mode.

sql.name: Buff Mobs (HPx2 / DMGx1.5 / ARMx1.5)
sql.desc: World tweak: mobs at 2x health, 1.5x damage/armor -- harder world.

sql.name: Extreme Buff Mobs (HPx4 / DMGx2 / ARMx2)
sql.desc: World tweak: mobs at 4x health, 2x damage/armor -- much harder world.

sql.name: Hearthstone Cooldown Tweaks
sql.desc: Pick a shorter Hearthstone cooldown (several variants to choose from).

sql.name: Level One Mounts (ride at level 1)
sql.desc: Mount training and riding available from level 1.

sql.name: Nerf Mobs (HPx0.5 / DMGx0.75 / ARMx0.75)
sql.desc: World tweak: mobs at half health, 0.75x damage/armor -- gentler world.

sql.name: NPC Teleporter (capital + starting zones)
sql.desc: Adds teleporter NPCs in capitals and starting zones.

sql.name: Portals in All Capitals
sql.desc: Two-way portals connecting all capital cities.

sql.name: Rare Drops (450 Classic rares loot)
sql.desc: About 450 Classic rare-spawn loot tables restored/enriched.
